span.p: Human in the loop: the nurse enters data at the start, the clinician approves at the gate.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 1. The case is ingested and the fields are validated.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 2. The local offline model turns the complaint into typed fields.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 3. The triage server matches SATS discriminators for the complaint.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 4. Deterministic code computes TEWS and returns a colour with citations.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 5. A verifier rejects any priority that arrives without a citation.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 6. Worsening vitals raise a second look flag, never a reclassification.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 7. The case pauses until a named clinician approves, edits, or dismisses it.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 8. Only after approval is a queue position written, by the gated tool.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 9. A sourced case card is rendered for the nurse.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Every tool call is written to the hash chained audit log. The whole path runs offline on synthetic data, with no external API.

flag a second look, never reclassify

span.p:

pause for a named clinician
